selection_rationale: cand_7f4b9a2d (end-to-end generate→verify→repair) best matches the programme goals: it directly targets a documented gap (integration of deterministic verifiers with LLM proposals), is experimentally falsifiable with a paired design and clear primary outcome (violation-rate reduction), is computationally feasible within budget, and yields operationally meaningful evidence about reliability/safeguards for agentic NetOps.
unresolved_uncertainties: Exact verifier modeling coverage and how verifier false-positives/negatives will affect measured violation rates.
Realism and provenance of the dataset/topologies (risk of synthetic overfitting vs real-world diversity).
Determinism of the repair mapping: how verifier diagnostics are transformed into repair prompts without ad-hoc tuning.
Handling tasks/features that the chosen verifier cannot model (exclusion vs separate analysis).
Latency/resource trade-offs and prompt-sensitivity (different prompt phrasings or seeds may materially change repair performance).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact deterministic verifier/tool and version (e.g., Batfish vX or Minesweeper vY), enumerate its modeling coverage, and list properties that will be checked and any failure modes to be excluded.

Provide precise dataset and topology provenance: public repository links or synthetic-generation scripts, inclusion/exclusion rules, sampling seeds, and balancing procedure across task types (VLAN/ACL/static-route).

Freeze and publish all prompting artifacts in the preregistration: initial LLM prompt, repair-prompt templates, repair-iteration termination rule, max-iterations (N), retry policy, and exact random seeds.
Predefine deterministic mapping rules from verifier-detected faults → repair-prompt inputs (template fields, prioritized diagnostics) so repairs are reproducible and not ad-hoc.

Pre-register how verifier-unmodelable features will be handled (explicit exclusion criteria, separate reporting cohort, or alternative validator) and ensure those cases are omitted from the primary paired analysis.
Define validator-ground-truth procedure for measuring verifier false-negatives (e.g., golden-config replay, oracle simulator, or manual adjudication) and publish the adjudication protocol.

Pre-register statistical analysis details (primary test: paired McNemar for pass/fail; effect-size metrics; 95% CIs; multiple-comparison control method such as Benjamini–Hochberg) and planned sensitivity analyses.
Document latency/cost accounting assumptions (token/model-call cost, measurement of per-iteration latency) and predefine the latency budget and stopping rules tied to operational constraints.
